scope: Browser follow-up of the existing named synthetic property matter, one matter at a time. No other matter was run in this milestone.
general_changes: Pinned all text roles to the authorised mini snapshot under an explicit same-model review policy.
Research V5 checks legal application premises against exact attributed advocate references and preserves unresolved conditions; historical V4 is readable but is not reused as current research.
Selected legal passages are bound to accepted uses; work and question identity are checked separately from displayed paragraph ownership.
Authorised review reaches the existing dispute and material readers without requiring invented new facts.
Existing record reviewers expose account-layer, every-target and required-restoration-peer checks. Missing accepted successors preserve the prior record and raw model decision.
Malformed adapter output and incomplete completion enter the existing single conditional correction. Pending-ID feedback preserves exact failed checks without logging source passage text.
Eligible restoration peers exclude the proposal itself and unrelated targets; singleton/no-overlap peer pools are empty. Admission rules remain strict.

browser_results.finding: Shared-paragraph ownership rule rejected separately identified question and next-work proposals; authorised record review did not reach readers.
browser_results.general_remedy: Separate proposal identity from display-block identity and route authorised reconciliation to readers.

browser_results.finding: Draft criticism and NM legal analysis replaced independent reported conduct and material.
browser_results.general_remedy: Explicit account-layer and per-target checks, collective successor dependencies and precise continuation-link diagnostics. Live semantic acceptance remained unproved.

browser_results.finding: Independent dispute review remained invalid after one correction. Generic feedback obscured the failed contract.
browser_results.general_remedy: Preserve exact per-pending-ID validation causes for conditional correction and backend diagnosis.

browser_results.finding: A proposal listed itself as its required restoration peer.
browser_results.general_remedy: Constrain variable peer ownership in prompt, packet and supported generation/local schemas. Retry the same unsaved brief; no account was readmitted.

browser_results.finding: Model copied the earlier analytical critique back into the board and material record. Its positive account check cited only review instructions as support. Both legal reads failed, and the writer was withheld for unsupported blocks and complete legal-enquiry status without checked passages.
remaining_invariants: Authority to review a record is distinct from evidence supporting its substantive content.
A holistic positive grounding vote cannot substitute for source-level content support.
A factual work product about a legal matter is distinct from a fresh legal-authority enquiry.
A semantic rejection should support bounded extractor correction while preserving valid peers and original account lineage.

call_inventory.conditional_corrections: Each read/reviewer allows one contract correction. Research uses actual fitting batches with pending-only correction. Writer/reviewer repair is bounded to six calls for a single request or eight for mixed requests; exceptional opening recovery can add up to six calls.
call_inventory.cache_contract: Same owner, scope, fact fingerprint, corpus revision and current V5 verification. Full saved conversation is retained.

limitations: No end-to-end, legal-accuracy or four-matter acceptance is claimed. Historical responses and exact original account words remain preserved. No donor snippet, scenario-specific branch, keyword exception or source-validation bypass was introduced.
